items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Wild
items.detail: Collect from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Collect Pre-war Food
items.detail: Gather from a C.A.M.P. food production item or find in Sunday Brothers' Cabin basement.

items.title: Collect Wood
items.detail: Harvest from wood piles at Prickett's Fort, Sylvie & Sons Logging Camp, or Smith Farm.

items.title: Complete the Event: "Grahm's Meat-Cook"
items.detail: Seasonal event at Moonshiner's Shack during Meat Week; check World Activity tab hourly.

items.title: Cook a Meat-Based Meal
items.detail: Use a Cooking Station with meat recipes like Wolf Ribs or Ribeye Steak.

items.title: Kill Animals with a Pipe Gun
items.detail: Hunt squirrels and rabbits near The Whitespring Resort exterior.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Feral Ghouls at The Whitespring Golf Club clubhouse are easy targets.

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; use laser rifles, plasma guns, or tesla rifles.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at a Tinker's Workbench, or loot from energy weapon-wielding enemies.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. to collect board games like Blast Radius or Autopsy.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Visit RobCo Research Center for consistent robot spawns of all types.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Gather from natural locations or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P. for easier collection.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt events during the Slasher seasonal event's final stage.

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find at Pumpkin House kitchen table or buy from Mr Waiter/Ms Waitress at The Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon or craft grenades to sell; multiple vendors available at The Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their shelter marked with a radiation symbol.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Finish six daily challenges on three separate days during the week.
